item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Indigo De Souza + Mothe @ Fonda Theatre 2026-03-05
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.


Usually when recording, you are committed for the duration so I always feel I have to explain an incomplete recording. I had a free ticket and really enjoyed her brief set in the park at Berniepalooza the year before. This night I was just so bored. She rambled way too much, even rambling about management telling her not to ramble so much because she runs over time. By the time I walked out I knew it was supposed be over by then and however many songs she had left, it wasn't worth getting home an hour or two later. Enjoy!
